integrity: The infinite statement is proved analytically from the exact distance-multiset types of omitted vertices. Computation independently stress-tests the theorem on all subsets through \(n=8\). No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to crown graphs with \(n\ge3\). The finite verifier covers \(3\le n\le8\) and is not an infinite proof. The recent toroidal-grid source was accessible through metadata and abstract but not as full text during this review; an older poorly indexed equivalent crown-graph result remains a residual originality risk.
title: Outer multiset dimension and all resolving sets of crown graphs
